data.one_liner: Fetch accurate current time from an NTP server as a DateTime object.
data.what_it_does: The package implements the NTP protocol in pure Dart and provides functions to obtain the clock offset or a corrected DateTime. It works on all major platforms without native code.
use_when: Device clock may be tampered or inaccurate
You need a reliable timestamp for time‑based events
Simple NTP sync without adding heavy networking libraries
avoid_when: High‑frequency or sub‑second synchronization is required
You need full NTP client features like multiple servers or authentication
Timezone or locale‑aware date handling is needed
weaknesses: Only a single default NTP server (time.google.com)
No built‑in caching or advanced NTP features
No automatic retry or fallback logic
